findings.title: Heads that carry the difference (exact patching)

findings.title: Circuit (who talks to whom)

findings.title: Causal verification
findings.text: 4/4 top components move the metric in the gradient-attributed direction when ablated. head 23.9: predicted -2.61, measured -2.52; head 20.9: predicted -2.03, measured -1.65; head 20.12: predicted -1.27, measured -0.73; neuron 23.2539: predicted +0.78, measured +0.69. Gaps between predicted and measured indicate indirect effects or backup circuits.
